title: "Introduction to Clinical Data Analysis in R"
subtitle: "A Practical Guide to Data Management, Statistical Analysis, and Interpretation"

*Bernard Isekah Osang'ir and Vương Mỹ Lượng* · Neudata

The participant handbook is our book **Introduction to Clinical Data Analysis in R** — *A Practical Guide to Data Management, Statistical Analysis, and Interpretation*. Each chapter explains the theory behind a method, shows the R code and its real output on the case-study data, with figures and tables, and ends with exercises. Worked solutions are at the end of the book.
